summary: Three documentation lies: wrong flag name, missing glob support, and incorrect exit code on missing files.

findings.title: Flag mismatch: docs say --count, code implements --times
findings.evidence: README and docs/cli.md document `--count`; argparse defines `--times` only.
findings.suggested_fix: Either rename the flag to `--count` or update docs to `--times`.

findings.title: Docs claim glob / --recursive support that does not exist
findings.evidence: README mentions globs `src/**/*.py` and docs list `--recursive`; cli.py has neither.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove glob/--recursive claims or implement them.

findings.title: Missing-file exit code is 2, docs say 0
findings.evidence: Docs: exit 0 on missing file. Code returns 2.
findings.suggested_fix: Align docs to exit code 2, or change return to 0 if non-fatal is intended.
